description: This file contains unit tests for the SiloHealthMonitor component in the Orleans project. It tests various scenarios such as successful probes, failed probes due to timeout or exception, indirect probing through intermediary silos, and handling of stale silos to ensure correct health check behavior.

classes.name: SiloHealthMonitorTests
classes.description: Unit test class for the Orleans SiloHealthMonitor, testing probe success, failure, indirect probing, and stale silo handling.

methods.name: Shutdown
methods.description: Gracefully stops the SiloHealthMonitor and completes all pending timer calls.

methods.name: SiloHealthMonitor_SuccessfulProbe
methods.description: Tests a successful probe where the target silo responds without issues.

methods.name: SiloHealthMonitor_FailedProbe_Timeout
methods.description: Tests behavior when a direct probe times out, resulting in a failure status.

methods.name: SiloHealthMonitor_FailedProbe_Exception
methods.description: Tests behavior when a direct probe throws an exception.

methods.name: SiloHealthMonitor_Indirect_FailedProbe
methods.description: Tests probe failure when the indirect probe response indicates failure.

methods.name: SiloHealthMonitor_IndirectProbe_SkipsStaleSilo
methods.description: Ensures that stale (inactive for a long time) silos are skipped for indirect probing.

methods.name: Silo
methods.description: Helper method to parse a string into a SiloAddress object.

methods.name: Entry
methods.description: Helper method to create a MembershipEntry with specified address, status, and timestamp.
